runtime_contract_lineage_repair.description: Exact Unified-Registry -> Hash-Lineage -> runtime-contract repair scope. It permits only the canonical contract registry, its active runtime projection, strict hash/interface guards, Agent3 exact-path semantic repair, completed-contract projection, Agent stage Artifact refs and structured current-state failure projection. Runtime membership may change only when the added/removed file is explicitly allowlisted or owned by an explicitly allowed registry module. All unrelated production files, modules, nodes and special hashes remain fail-closed.
